backup_description: The backup file includes all transactions from your payments balance.
backup_file_not_selected: Optional — restore from recovery phrase only
backup_file_section_description: Optionally add your wallet backup file to restore your transaction history and wallet data. Without it, your funds are recovered from the network, but local history is not restored.
linked_devices_multiple_devices_descript: Only your primary device can spend. Secondary devices can view balance and history.
linked_devices_no_active_wallet_descript: Make this device your primary wallet to send and receive.
linked_devices_single_device_description: You're using Arké on one device. Install Arké on another iPhone or iPad signed in to the same iCloud, and it'll appear here automatically. View-only at first, ready to take over if you need it.
notification_error_permission_denied: Notification permission denied. Please enable in Settings.
notification_vtxo_refresh_body: Your wallet needs maintenance to keep your funds fresh. Open the app to refresh.
settings_address_patterns_experimental: This is an experimental feature. Patterns are most useful when you can compare them across apps — and for now, Arké is the first wallet to show them. Think of it as a preview of what address checking could feel like.
settings_address_patterns_explainer: Every address gets its own unique pattern, generated from the address itself. A glance is enough to tell whether two addresses match, without comparing them character by character.
settings_address_patterns_hint: Show unique visual patterns to help identify addresses
settings_bitcoin_format_help: Choose how bitcoin amounts are displayed throughout the app.
settings_delete_backup_reminder: Have you completed a manual backup? You need both your recovery phrase and wallet state file to fully restore your wallet.
settings_delete_balance_warning: You still have funds in your wallet. Make sure to transfer them out before deleting, or accept that small amounts below minimum fees may not be recoverable.
settings_delete_permanent_warning_everyw: All wallet data will be permanently deleted from this device and iCloud. No turning back.
settings_delete_permanent_warning_local_: All wallet data will be permanently deleted from this device. Your other devices keep this wallet — open one of them to make it the active device.
settings_delete_warning_device: This will permanently delete your wallet from this device.
settings_delete_warning_icloud: This will permanently delete your wallet from this device and iCloud. All linked devices will lose access.
settings_delete_warning_local_only: This will permanently delete your wallet from this device. Your other devices keep access to the wallet.
settings_forced_move_duration_warning: This takes about 10+ hours and cannot be cancelled.
settings_make_primary_help: This device will become your active wallet, able to send and receive payments.
settings_make_secondary_help: This device will switch to view-only mode. Make sure you have your other device ready to make it primary.
settings_manage_devices: Manage devices that have access to your wallet
settings_notifications_explainer_outro: Arké can only remind you of these when notifications are enabled.
settings_offline_backup_help: An offline backup needs both items below. Your recovery phrase alone won't recover your full balance. The backup file holds data that exists only on your device and in iCloud.
settings_proximity_sharing_hint: Share payment info with nearby devices when tilting
settings_recovery_phrase_help: Your recovery phrase restores your wallet. Anyone who has it can spend your bitcoin. Keep it safe and never share it.
settings_unlink_all_help: Use this if you've lost a device or want to revoke access from all other devices. This cannot be undone.
settings_unlink_all_warning: All other devices will lose access to the wallet. They will need to re-import the recovery phrase to regain access. This action cannot be undone.
